Introduction

Mingkai is a Chinese trainee under TOV Entertainment and a member of the upcoming boy group AM8IC. He is also known for competing on the survival show Starlight Boys. On July 16, 2024, he was introduced as a member of the male trainee group YOUTOVE under TOV Entertainment. On September 29, 2024, he appeared as a contestant on the Chinese–South Korean survival show Starlight Boys. He was eliminated in episode 9 on December 21. On September 2, 2025, Mingkai was revealed as a member of AM8IC.
